content.scenario: The National Commission passes an order in favor of a consumer, but the company refuses to comply with the order. The consumer wants to know how the order will be enforced.
content.outcome: The National Commission shall enforce its order in the same manner as if it were a decree made by a Court, as per Section 71 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, and the provisions of Order XXI of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 shall apply, subject to certain modifications.

user_queries: How are orders enforced by the National Commission?
What provisions apply to the enforcement of orders?
Can the National Commission enforce its orders like a court?
